checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, or fee reference in bot output. Even framing like 'around $X' or 'about half the price' counts.
bot claims a program exists that is NOT one of: Adult Gracie Combatives, Kids 7-13 BJJ. Also flag any source-bleed program names from other gyms (e.g. Ballantyne, Vacaville program names).
bot says it is an AI, bot, automated system, virtual assistant, or similar. Emma must present as a human front desk employee at all times.
bot says 'you're all set', 'you're booked', or similar confirmation WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first. Confirmation must be gated on actual booking success.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'I don't currently have', 'let me check', 'I'll look that up' on questions where it should give a firm known answer. Hedging when the answer is a known no is a UX failure.

checkpoints.description: No booking before collecting required fields
checkpoints.look_for: bot calls the booking tool before collecting first name, last name, email, phone, and DOB for the adult contact. All five fields required before booking.
bot output contains unreplaced merge tokens like {{contact.first_name}}, {{variable}}, {{nodes.X.result}}.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks something like 'who is this for — you, a child, or both?' before collecting names, DOBs, or other personal details.

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks for date of birth (not just age) for every enrollee before calling the booking tool. Verbal age alone is not sufficient.
when an adult enrolls, the booking tool uses 'Adult Gracie Combatives' calendar. Any other calendar name is a routing failure.
when a kid aged 7-13 enrolls, the booking tool uses 'Kids 7-13 BJJ' calendar. Any other calendar name is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: if lead pushes for pricing 2+ times, bot firmly redirects to in-person or team follow-up. Does not eventually cave and give a number.

checkpoints.description: Unaccompanied minor handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: if lead is under 18 with no parent involved, bot must NOT attempt booking. Must capture name + DOB + parent contact info, then close with team-will-follow-up framing.

checkpoints.description: Kids under 7 redirected to staff — no booking attempted
checkpoints.look_for: if a parent's child is under 7 years old, bot must NOT attempt to book. Must acknowledge the program isn't available online and redirect to staff/in-person.

if lead asks about Cardio Kickboxing, Kickboxing / Filipino Martial Arts, Master Cycle, Black Belt Club, or Reflex Development, bot acknowledges the program exists but redirects to in-person discussion. Does NOT attempt to book these.

checkpoints.description: Free trial framing — no membership commitment language
checkpoints.look_for: bot frames the booking as a free trial class, not a membership sign-up or ongoing commitment.
